title: play.rs joins the Link session: capture at playback time with latency, session tempo, start/stop, messages
description:
## Intent
`apricity play --link`: the play loop joins the session and the mixer follows it. Makes apricitus-5a32fd, apricitus-94776e and apricitus-392ae1 green.

## Steps
1. `crates/apricity-cli/src/play.rs`: when linked, join with the score's tempo and the quantum; in `open_device`'s cpal callback, capture the session at the buffer's playback instant plus output latency and the `--latency` offset, and pass the clock line to the `Mixer` (M1); the `silent_clock` path does the same on its virtual time.
2. Arrange at the session's tempo through M1's tempo watcher; report "tempo N is not used while linked" on a save that changes `tempo`.
3. Messages exactly as the stories say (peers, tempo, waiting, stopped, keeping tempo); the status line shows "bar · beat · N peers · BPM".
4. Start/stop: wait for the session when sharing start/stop; `--no-start-stop` starts at the next bar line; Ctrl-C leaves the session without touching it.

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricity-cli --test link_play` (those stories green) and `cargo test -p apricity-engine` still green.

Commit: `feat(<this task id>): apricity play --link`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
